consent.notice:
Hi, welcome to WAOOAW! 👋 We help growing businesses work with digital professionals, like a marketing specialist who studies your customers, plans your content and keeps you posted. You guide the work in about ten minutes a day.

Before we chat: I'll keep our messages for up to {retentionDays} days to run this demo (privacy notice: https://cp.demo.waooaw.com/privacy). This does not create an account, and I won't send marketing messages.

Tap YES to continue, or STOP at any time.
consent.accepted: Thanks, you're all set! 🎉 Tell me about your business: what do you do, and in which city?
consent.registeredNumberAccepted: Thanks, you're all set! 🎉 This number already has a WAOOAW account. Sign in at https://cp.demo.waooaw.com to pick up where you left off; this chat stays separate from your account history. Meanwhile, tell me about your business: what do you do, and in which city?
consent.renewalUnavailable: We've updated our notice, so we need your OK again. Tap YES to continue, or STOP at any time.

fixed.closedNotice: Thanks for messaging WAOOAW! I'm here every day from 9 am to 9 pm IST. Please message me again then. Reply STOP to stop messages.
fixed.unsupportedContent: I can only read typed messages and taps for now. Could you type that instead? 🙂
fixed.stopAcknowledged: You're opted out and won't get any more messages from us. Send START any time to chat again.
fixed.resumeNotice: Welcome back! 👋 To start again I need your OK once more. Tap YES to continue, or STOP at any time.

showValue.intro:
Here's how that could work for a {domain}: our Digital Marketing Professional {valueLine}. {example}

Would you like a sample first month, or to hear what it can do?

familyExamples.health: For example, a clinic could get more new-patient enquiries by collecting honest Google reviews and sharing simple health tips.
familyExamples.beauty_wellness: For example, a studio could fill quiet slots by sharing before-and-after stories and making booking a one-tap step.
familyExamples.food: For example, a restaurant could bring in regulars by sharing today's specials and answering reviews quickly.
familyExamples.professional: For example, a practice could win more of the right clients by sharing useful tips and keeping its Google profile sharp.
familyExamples.property: For example, a property business could attract serious buyers by sharing neighbourhood guides and answering enquiries fast.
familyExamples.education: For example, a coaching business could reach more parents by sharing study tips and student stories.
familyExamples.retail: For example, a shop could bring more people through the door by sharing new arrivals and keeping its Google listing fresh.
familyExamples.general: For example, a local business could be found more easily by keeping its Google profile fresh and sharing useful posts.

showValue.skills:
Here's what the Digital Marketing Professional can do:
• Know your customers: works out who they are and what they want
• Study your market: sees how you compare with others nearby
• Plan your content: builds a calendar of posts and keeps it going

You approve the important steps and can stop it at any time.
